The name Lebo carries the meaning “Dedicated to God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Lebo usually hope their child will grow to embody dedicated to god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
